subject.title: [Feature]: Stage full migrations before guided onboarding

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a CLI-only staged full-migration substrate before moving full imports earlier in guided onboarding, with Control UI and macOS support deferred?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new migration lifecycle across config, SQLite state, workspace artifacts, onboarding sequencing, cancellation recovery, and external Codex effects; choosing its product boundary and rollout cannot be resolved safely from the issue text alone.

options.title: Sponsor the staged CLI substrate
options.body: Approve a bounded first PR for host-owned staging, verification, promotion, and recovery journaling, then separately move the guided choice earlier.

options.title: Keep current onboarding flow
options.body: Retain the post-inference full-import sequence until a broader migration framework has an approved owner and design.

options.title: Narrow to an existing migration path
options.body: Ask for a smaller proposal that improves a confirmed current failure without introducing a general staging substrate.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged CLI substrate
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded first PR for host-owned staging, verification, promotion, and recovery journaling, then separately move the guided choice earlier.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal contains the requested design boundary and sequencing, though source-history ownership remains unverified.
